methodologyNotes: Fourteen spearguns spanning wood, aluminum, and pneumatic designs were verified 2026-08-11 against manufacturer pages (JBL, Rob Allen, Cressi, Mares, Beuchat) and major retailers (speargun.com/RIFFE, adreno.com.au, American Diving Supply, scuba.com, Blue Tuna Spearfishing, Hammerhead's own store); effective_range_ft is left null across every entry because no source in this roster publishes a quantified effective-range figure (it is universally marketing copy, not a spec) rather than an estimate; priceUsd is left null with a priceNote for the three entries (Rob Allen Tuna Railgun, Rob Allen Scorpia, Beuchat Marlin Evil 2) whose only located retail listings were in AUD/EUR, since converting currency would be guessing a USD price no seller has published; "Riffe Standard Series" from the seed list does not exist as a current RIFFE product name, so it was mapped to RIFFE's actual current entry-tier wood line, the Mahogany Competitor Series (successor/equivalent to the old "Standard" naming), noted in that product's provenance; each speargun is priced/spec'd at one representative barrel-length variant (noted per product) since these guns are sold across 4-10 length options at different prices from the same product page.

products.name: JBL Woody Elite 44" Sawed-Off
products.priceNote: 44" Sawed-Off variant; JBL sells five lengths (29"-62") from $420-$620

specs.bands: 2x 5/8 in (16mm) Elite Nitro Bands, expandable to 3

products.provenance: JBL's official Woody Elite product page lists five barrel lengths (29" Custom, 36" 38 Special, 44" Sawed-Off, 56" Magnum, 62" Magnum 450) at $420-$620, a mahogany barrel with 17-4 heat-treated stainless spearshaft, standard dual 5/8 in Elite Nitro Bands (expandable to a third band), an integrated reel eyelet with universal rail mount on all but the Custom model, and positive buoyancy without the shaft loaded. The 44" Sawed-Off ($510) was chosen as the representative reel-ready variant; shaft diameter is left null because the page only confirms 9/32 in for the separate Custom model and describes other sizes only by thread spec (5/16 in threads), not shaft diameter.

products.name: JBL Magnum 51" Competition Magnum
products.priceNote: 51" Competition Magnum variant; JBL sells five lengths (37"-63") from $380-$420

specs.bands: 2x 5/8 in (16mm) Nitro Bands with COMPOUND X
specs.buoyancy: floats without spearshaft loaded (integrated barrel float chamber)

products.provenance: JBL's official Magnum Spearguns page (rebuilt on the Reaper platform, distinct from the wood Woody Elite "Magnum" length option) documents a 1 1/8 in aircraft-grade aluminum barrel, 5/16 in (7.9mm) heat-treated stainless shaft with 6mm threads and triple-notch Add-A-Band design, dual 5/8 in Nitro Bands, an integrated reel/accessory mount, and an integrated float chamber for buoyancy without the shaft. Five lengths (37"-63") are priced $380-$420; the 51" Competition Magnum was chosen as the mid-size representative.

products.name: Riffe Euro Series E-55
products.priceNote: Base E-55 model; nine sizes up to E-120 range $720-$875 on speargun.com

specs.bands: 2x 5/8 in (16mm) RIFFE Gorilla Rubber, accepts up to 3x 9/16 in

products.provenance: RIFFE's authorized dealer page (speargun.com) for the Euro Series documents a rectangular 3-strip laminated teak barrel with Mag-Track free-shafting, 9/32 in (7.1mm) Hawaiian flopper Euroshaft, standard dual 5/8 in Gorilla Rubber bands (up to three 9/16 in bands total), built-in stainless reel-mount inserts, and nine sizes E-55 through E-120 priced $720-$875. The smallest E-55 was used as the priced representative; buoyancy figures are not published on this listing.

products.name: Riffe Mahogany Competitor Series #00
products.priceNote: Base #00 size; seven sizes (#00 to #3X) range $546-$622 on speargun.com
products.provenance: The seed name "Riffe Standard Series" does not correspond to any current RIFFE product; RIFFE's current lineup (per speargun.com and its data-specs sheet) is Sabre, Raider, Marauder, Mahogany Competitor, and Euro. The Mahogany Competitor Series is RIFFE's entry wood line and the closest real match to a "standard" wood gun, sold in sizes #00 through #3X for $546-$622 with a solid mahogany stock, standard 9/16 in power bands (upgradable to 5/8 in), and a standard Hawaiian setup using a 9/32 in (7.1mm) flopper shaft (1/4 in-3/8 in also offered). Barrel length in cm/in and reel-readiness are not stated on this listing (sizes are given only as model codes #00-#3X), so those fields are left null rather than inferred.

products.name: Rob Allen Tuna Railgun 1m
products.priceNote: No USD price published; Rob Allen sells through a South African/Australian dealer network and its own site does not list consumer pricing
products.provenance: Rob Allen's official South African product page for the Tuna Railgun lists ten lengths (70cm-1.6m), an aircraft-grade hard-anodized aluminum barrel with an extended integrated rail supporting the shaft into the muzzle, dual 16mm rubber bands, a 7.5mm double-notched spear, a Vecta Blue handle with built-in reel mount, and a Vecta Low Profile muzzle (open or closed). No consumer price is published on roballen.co.za, which operates a dealer-only sales model; the 1m (100cm) length was used as the mid-range representative.

products.name: Rob Allen Scorpia 90cm
products.priceNote: $399.99 AUD listed at adreno.com.au; no USD manufacturer price published
products.provenance: Adreno's Rob Allen Scorpia listing (an authorized Rob Allen dealer) documents a 1mm-thick aviation-grade aluminum railgun barrel with a glass-filled nylon body, single 16mm rubber band with Dyneema wishbone, a 7.0mm hardened spring-steel spear (6.6mm on the 70/80cm sizes), a Vecta 2 handle, and six lengths from 70cm-120cm at AUD 399.99 for the 90/110cm listing. No USD price is published by Rob Allen or this dealer, so priceUsd is left null per the no-conversion rule rather than estimating an exchange rate.

products.name: Cressi Comanche Rail 90cm
products.priceNote: Sale price on cressi-usa.com (list $179.95); Comanche Rail sold in 5 lengths (60-110cm)
products.provenance: Cressi's official store page for the Comanche Rail speargun documents a 28mm Anticorodal aluminum frame with integrated shaft guide rail, thermoplastic grip and muzzle, a dovetail reel connection, a 6.0mm heat-treated 17-4 PH notched stainless shaft, standard 16mm power bands (18mm S45 or 20mm G20 upgrades for longer models), and five lengths from 60cm (55cm barrel) to 110cm. cressi-usa.com lists a $84.04 sale price (from $179.95 list) for the line; the 90cm size was used as the mid-range representative.

products.name: Cressi Apache 75cm
products.priceNote: American Diving Supply retail price; Apache sold in 4 lengths (35-75cm)

specs.bands: 13mm circular black natural latex sling (1-2 bands)

products.provenance: American Diving Supply's Cressi Apache listing (Cressi's own store.cressi.com corroborates the barrel spec) documents a 26mm anodized aluminum open-head barrel, a 6.5mm stainless Euro shaft with 7mm threads (1-2 power bands), a 13mm circular black natural latex sling with 35-75cm shaft options, and a $114.95 retail price. The 75cm length was used as the priced representative.

products.name: Mares Viper Pro DS 75cm
products.priceNote: Base 75cm price at American Diving Supply; longer lengths up to 120cm priced higher

specs.bands: 2x 16mm S-Power speed circular slings with Dyneema wishbone

products.provenance: American Diving Supply's listing for the Mares Viper Pro DS (also on mares.com as "Viper Pro DS") describes a top-of-range dual-band sling gun with a rigid anodized aluminum barrel, upper shaft guide and lower line guide, an open muzzle with off-axis holes, a stainless trigger mechanism with handle-mounted shark clip, a 6.5mm single-barb Tahitian shaft, dual 16mm S-Power circular slings, and five lengths (75-120cm) starting at $299.95 for the 75cm model.

products.name: Mares Sniper Alpha 35cm
products.priceNote: American Diving Supply price (on sale from $147.95); Sniper Alpha sold in 4 lengths (35-90cm)
products.provenance: American Diving Supply's Mares Sniper Alpha listing documents a 28mm anodized aluminum outer barrel, a galvanized PR80 steel shaft with 7mm threads and a single-barb bullet tip, vertical Spiro reel compatibility, an ergonomic handle, four lengths (35/45/55/75-90cm across sources), and a sale price of $119.95 (from $147.95). Band diameter and precise shaft diameter are not stated on this listing (only the thread spec and reel compatibility are), so those two fields are left null rather than assumed from other Mares models.

products.name: Beuchat Marlin Evil 2 Double Sling 90cm
products.priceNote: EUR254.00 (VAT incl.) on beuchat-sports.com; no USD price published
products.provenance: Beuchat's own store (the brand's official site, which explicitly warns of imitation sites) lists the Marlin Evil 2 Double Sling as the current descendant of the plain "Marlin" name (the standalone "Marlin" model has been superseded by the Evil/Evil Open/Evil 2 sub-line). It documents a 28mm corrosion-resistant aluminum tube with full-length integrated guide rail, an open muzzle, a Marlin soft-touch handle, a 6.5mm shaft, dual 14mm Megatonne slings, five lengths (75-120cm), and pre-rigging with an Activ 30 reel, at EUR254.00. No USD price is published, so priceUsd is left null rather than converted.

products.name: Salvimar Predathor Pneumatic 55cm
products.priceNote: Low end of $254.95-$337.95 Walmart-listed range across lengths/variants; Salvimar does not publish direct consumer MSRP
products.provenance: Retailer listings (scuba.com, Walmart, Amazon, and German dealer spearfishing.de) for the Salvimar Predathor pneumatic speargun agree on a round alloy barrel in four lengths (40/55/65/75cm), an 8.0mm shaft, and widened muzzle ports for reduced drag on piston exit; Walmart's listed price range is $254.95-$337.95 across length/variant. bands is left null because this is a pneumatic (air-piston) gun with no rubber power bands. The 55cm length was used as the priced representative.

products.name: HammerHead Evolution² 55cm
products.priceNote: Base gun price for the shortest (55cm) length; longer lengths plus optional reel/muzzle upgrades range up to $638.99

specs.bands: 2x Power Helix bands with Dyneema-coated nylon wishbones/bridles (diameter not published)

products.provenance: HammerHead's own webstore product page for the Evolution² documents an open-muzzle, reverse-trigger design with an aircraft-grade anodized aluminum barrel and integrated shaft guide, American-made 17-4 heat-treated stainless shafts, dual Power Helix bands with Dyneema-coated wishbones and bridles, eight lengths (55-130cm) priced $328.99-$378.99 for the bare gun ($328.99-$638.99 with optional Remora reel upgrades), and standard rigging with mono shooting line and a front bungee. Band diameter and shaft diameter in mm are not stated on this page, so both are left null; a reel is sold as a separate optional accessory rather than included, so reel_ready is left null rather than assumed false.

products.name: Omer Cayman Sport 75cm
products.priceNote: Blue Tuna Spearfishing listing for the 75cm size (45/55/65/75cm range $180-$210); listed sold out at time of access
products.provenance: Blue Tuna Spearfishing's Omer Cayman Sport listing documents a 28mm anodized aluminum "cuttlefish bone" shaped barrel, a PR80 threaded 6.5mm shaft with 4-metal-point nylon prong, a single 16.5mm Top Energy rubber band with standard wishbone, four lengths (45/55/65/75cm) priced $180-$210, and notes all sizes as sold out at time of access (accessedAt is the page-access date, not a stock guarantee). Seminole Scuba's parallel Cayman Sport listing (90/100cm sizes, same 28mm/6.5mm/16mm spec) corroborates the core specs. The 75cm/$210 size was used as the priced representative.
